title: Mini Test 01
source: WordFlow – đề tự soạn theo format TOEIC

parts.directions: You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English. They will not be printed in your test book. Select the best response to the question or statement.

script.text: Where should I put these boxes of printer paper?
A. Yes, I printed it this morning.
B. In the supply closet next to the elevator.
C. About twenty sheets.

options: Yes, I printed it this morning.
In the supply closet next to the elevator.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Where → cần một địa điểm. (A) bẫy âm giống: printer → printed, và câu hỏi WH không trả lời bằng Yes. (C) trả lời số lượng (How many).

script.text: Has the budget report been approved yet?
A. The director is still reviewing it.
B. A new report card.
C. Yes, I'd like to.

options: The director is still reviewing it.
questions.explain: Trả lời gián tiếp: không nói Yes/No mà cho biết giám đốc vẫn đang xem → tức là chưa duyệt. Đây là dạng đáp án đúng rất hay gặp. (B) lặp từ report, (C) có Yes nhưng không hợp nghĩa.

script.text: Could you send me the client's phone number?
A. He's a new client.
B. Sure, I'll e-mail it to you right away.
C. No, I don't have a cell phone.

options: Sure, I'll e-mail it to you right away.
No, I don't have a cell phone.
questions.explain: Câu yêu cầu Could you…? → đồng ý (Sure / Of course) hoặc từ chối có lý do. (A) lặp từ client, (C) lặp từ phone: bẫy lặp từ.

script.text: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
A. The flight was delayed.
B. Please have a seat.
C. Either is fine with me.

questions.explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn A or B: đáp án có thể chọn A, chọn B, hoặc "cái nào cũng được" (Either is fine / I don't mind). (B) lặp từ seat.

script.text: The new coffee machine on the third floor isn't working.
A. I'll call the repair service.
B. Two sugars, please.
C. On the fourth floor.

questions.explain: Câu trần thuật nêu một vấn đề → đáp án thường là cách giải quyết. (B) liên tưởng coffee → sugar, (C) liên tưởng third floor → fourth floor.

script.text: When is the training session for new employees?
A. In Conference Room B.
B. Yes, about ten new staff members.
C. It's been moved to Thursday afternoon.

options: Yes, about ten new staff members.
It's been moved to Thursday afternoon.
questions.explain: When → thời gian. (A) trả lời Where, (B) có Yes nên loại ngay với câu hỏi WH. Mẹo: nghe kỹ từ để hỏi đầu câu.

parts.directions: You will hear some conversations between two or more people. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation.

script.text: Hi, Daniel. I'm putting together the order for office supplies. Do you need anything for your team?
Actually, yes. We're running low on toner for the color printer. We've got a big presentation for the Lexford account next week, and we'll need to print a lot of handouts.
OK, I'll add two cartridges. But just so you know, the supplier said orders placed after Wednesday won't arrive until the following Monday.
Hmm, that might be too late. I'll stop by the electronics store on my way home and pick some up myself.

questions.prompt: What is the woman preparing?
questions.explain: Câu đầu tiên: "I'm putting together the order for office supplies" → a supply order (paraphrase: office supplies → supply). Câu hỏi chủ đề thường nằm ở 1–2 câu đầu.
questions.evidence: putting together the order for office supplies

questions.prompt: What does the man say his team will do next week?
questions.explain: "We've got a big presentation for the Lexford account next week". (D) bẫy: có nhắc printer nhưng là hết mực, không phải sửa.
questions.evidence: big presentation for the Lexford account next week

questions.prompt: What will the man most likely do after work?
questions.explain: "I'll stop by the electronics store on my way home" → after work = on my way home; stop by the store = visit a store. Câu hỏi hành động tiếp theo thường nằm ở câu cuối.
questions.evidence: stop by the electronics store on my way home

script.text: Good morning, Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?
Hello, I'm organizing a dinner for our company's sales team on the fourteenth. I was hoping to reserve your private dining room for about twenty-five people.
Let me check. I'm afraid the private room only seats eighteen.
Oh. Well, we've already sent out the invitations.
In that case, we could reserve the back section of our main restaurant for you. It's quieter, and it can hold up to forty guests.
That sounds perfect. Could you e-mail me a copy of your set menus?

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
options: To reserve a space for an event
questions.explain: "I was hoping to reserve your private dining room" cho một bữa tối của công ty → reserve a space for an event. (A) bẫy: gọi đến khách sạn nhưng không đặt phòng ngủ.

questions.prompt: Why does the woman say, "we've already sent out the invitations"?
options: To confirm the date of the event
To indicate that the number of guests cannot be reduced
To ask for help writing invitations
To explain why she is calling late
questions.explain: Phòng chỉ đủ 18 người, mà thiệp mời đã gửi đi rồi → không thể giảm số khách. Câu hàm ý phải hiểu theo ngữ cảnh ngay TRƯỚC câu được trích.
questions.evidence: we've already sent out the invitations

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explain: "Could you e-mail me a copy of your set menus?" → send some menu options.
questions.evidence: e-mail me a copy of your set menus
vocab: có sức chứa (bao nhiêu chỗ ngồi)

parts.directions: You will hear some talks given by a single speaker. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk.

script.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Hartwell Manufacturing plant. Before we start the tour, I'd like to go over a few safety rules. Please wear the protective glasses we've handed out at all times while you're on the factory floor. Also, the machines are quite loud, so you'll each receive a headset that will let you hear me clearly. The tour will last about an hour, and at the end, we'll stop by the visitor center, where you can try samples of our newest products.

questions.prompt: Where most likely are the listeners?
questions.explain: "welcome to the Hartwell Manufacturing plant", "factory floor" → nhà máy (plant = factory).

questions.prompt: What will the listeners receive?
questions.explain: "you'll each receive a headset". Kính bảo hộ cũng được phát nhưng không có trong đáp án.

questions.prompt: What will the listeners be able to do at the end of the tour?
questions.explain: "at the end … you can try samples of our newest products" → try some products.
questions.evidence: try samples of our newest products

parts.directions: A word or phrase is missing in each of the sentences below. Four answer choices are given below each sentence. Select the best answer to complete the sentence.

questions.prompt: The marketing team will ------- the results of the customer survey at Friday's meeting.
questions.explain: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu will cần động từ nguyên mẫu → present. Mẹo: thấy will/can/should/must + chỗ trống → chọn V nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: Ms. Tanaka has worked at Corbin Financial ------- more than fifteen years.
questions.explain: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành + khoảng thời gian (fifteen years) → for. since + mốc thời gian (since 2010).

questions.prompt: All visitors must sign in at the front desk ------- entering the laboratory.
questions.explain: Theo nghĩa: phải đăng ký TRƯỚC KHI vào phòng thí nghiệm. before + V-ing dùng được; because/although phải đi với mệnh đề đầy đủ.
vocab: đăng ký vào (ký tên khi đến)

questions.prompt: The new software is ------- easier to use than the previous version.
questions.explain: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn dùng much/far/a lot/significantly + easier. very không đứng trước so sánh hơn; more easier là sai.

questions.prompt: Applicants should submit their résumés ------- e-mail by March 31.
questions.explain: by + phương tiện (by e-mail, by phone, by mail). Câu này có 2 lần by với 2 nghĩa: by e-mail (bằng) và by March 31 (trước hạn).

questions.prompt: Mr. Alvarez asked that all expense reports ------- by the end of the month.
questions.explain: Hai dấu hiệu: (1) ask that + S + V nguyên mẫu (giả định); (2) báo cáo được nộp → bị động. Gộp lại → be submitted.

questions.prompt: The company's profits increased ------- after the launch of its new product line.
questions.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ increased → trạng từ (-ly) significantly.

questions.prompt: Employees ------- wish to attend the workshop should register by Friday.
questions.explain: Chỗ trống đứng trước động từ wish, thay cho người (employees) làm chủ ngữ → who. whom làm tân ngữ, whose + danh từ.

questions.prompt: Please contact Ms. Park if you have any questions about ------- new schedule.
questions.explain: Đứng trước cụm danh từ (new schedule) → tính từ sở hữu her.

questions.prompt: By the time the director arrived, the meeting ------- already.
questions.explain: By the time + quá khứ đơn (arrived) → hành động xảy ra trước đó dùng quá khứ hoàn thành had started.

questions.prompt: The hotel offers free shuttle service to the airport for all ------- guests.
questions.explain: Cần tính từ trước danh từ guests. registered guests = khách đã đăng ký (bị động, V3). Cụm cố định hay gặp trong TOEIC.

questions.prompt: The renovation of the lobby is expected to be completed ------- schedule.
questions.explain: ahead of schedule = sớm hơn kế hoạch (ngược lại: behind schedule). Cụm rất hay gặp.

questions.prompt: ------- the weather was poor, the outdoor concert drew a large crowd.
questions.explain: Phía sau là mệnh đề (the weather was poor) và nghĩa tương phản → Although. Despite/Because of + danh từ; However không nối hai mệnh đề trong một câu.

questions.prompt: The sales figures for the third quarter were ------- than expected.
questions.explain: Có than → so sánh hơn higher.

questions.prompt: Keystone Electronics will ------- its warranty period from one year to two years.
questions.explain: extend = kéo dài (thời hạn bảo hành từ 1 lên 2 năm). expire = hết hạn (không có tân ngữ).

questions.prompt: Customers who are not completely satisfied may return the item for a full -------.
questions.explain: full refund = hoàn tiền toàn bộ: cụm cố định khi trả hàng.

parts.directions: Read the text that follows. A word, phrase, or sentence is missing in parts of the text. Select the best answer to complete the text.

passages.head:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Parking garage maintenance
Date: May 6
passages.text:
Please be advised that the parking garage on Elm Street will be closed for maintenance from Monday, May 13, to Friday, May 17. During this time, employees {{32}} to use the public parking lot on Fulton Avenue. The company will cover the cost of parking for that week. {{33}}

To receive a refund, simply submit your parking receipts to the front office {{34}} May 24. We apologize for any {{35}} this may cause and appreciate your patience.

questions.explain: Nhân viên ĐƯỢC khuyến khích dùng bãi khác → bị động are encouraged to + V.

options: The garage was built more than twenty years ago.
Please keep your receipts from each day you park there.
Fulton Avenue will also be closed next week.
Many employees prefer to take the train.
questions.explain: Câu trước: công ty trả phí gửi xe; câu sau: nộp biên lai để được hoàn tiền → cần câu nối nhắc giữ biên lai. Mẹo Part 6: đọc cả câu trước VÀ câu sau chỗ trống.
no later than + mốc thời gian = chậm nhất là. as soon as phải đi với mệnh đề.
Sau any cần danh từ; theo nghĩa xin lỗi vì sự BẤT tiện → inconvenience. "We apologize for any inconvenience" là câu cố định.

parts.directions: In this part you will read a selection of texts, such as magazine and newspaper articles, e-mails, and instant messages. Each text or set of texts is followed by several questions. Select the best answer for each question.

passages.head:
From: Laura Bennett <lbennett@greenfieldsuites.com>
To: Kevin Moore <kmoore@arcadiadesign.com>
Subject: Your reservation
Date: September 2
passages.text:
Dear Mr. Moore,

Thank you for choosing Greenfield Suites for your upcoming stay. This e-mail confirms your reservation for a deluxe room from September 18 to September 21.

As requested, we have arranged an airport pickup upon your arrival. Our driver will meet you in the arrivals hall holding a sign with your name.

Please note that our rooftop restaurant will be closed for renovations during your stay. However, guests may enjoy a complimentary breakfast at the Garden Café on the ground floor.

If you need to make any changes to your booking, please contact us at least 48 hours before your arrival date.

Sincerely,
Laura Bennett
Guest Services

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
questions.explain: "This e-mail confirms your reservation" → confirm a booking (reservation = booking). Mục đích thư thường nằm ở đoạn đầu.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Mr. Moore?
options: He asked for transportation from the airport.
He will stay at the hotel for one week.
He has stayed at the hotel before.
questions.explain: "As requested, we have arranged an airport pickup" → chính ông Moore đã yêu cầu xe đón. (B) sai: 18–21/9 chỉ 3 đêm.
questions.evidence: As requested, we have arranged an airport pickup

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
options: The length of Mr. Moore's stay
questions.explain: Câu NOT: dò từng đáp án. (A) 18–21/9 ✓, (B) complimentary breakfast ✓, (D) 48 hours before ✓. Giá phòng không được nhắc → (C).

passages.text:
Mia Chen [10:12 A.M.]: Hi Tom, are you still at the Westbrook client's office?
Tom Reyes [10:13 A.M.]: Yes, the meeting just ended. They loved the new logo designs.
Mia Chen [10:14 A.M.]: Great! Could you pick up the printed brochures from Copy Plus on your way back? They close at noon today.
Tom Reyes [10:15 A.M.]: I'm afraid I won't make it. I have to stop by the bank first.
Mia Chen [10:16 A.M.]: No problem. I'll ask Jenna.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the Westbrook client?
options: They were pleased with some designs.
They will visit the office at noon.
questions.explain: "They loved the new logo designs" → pleased with some designs (paraphrase loved → pleased).
questions.evidence: They loved the new logo designs

questions.prompt: At 10:15 A.M., what does Mr. Reyes mean when he writes, "I'm afraid I won't make it"?
options: He is unable to collect the brochures.
He will be late for lunch.
He forgot to visit the bank.
questions.explain: Mia nhờ lấy tài liệu trước 12h; Tom phải ghé ngân hàng trước → không kịp lấy brochure. make it = kịp, đến được.
questions.evidence: I'm afraid I won't make it
